voice.summary: Coastline writes like a gallery wall label: short, factual and respectful of the work. Titles, mediums and years carry the information, leaving the images to do the talking.
dos: Label each piece with title, medium and year
Use one sentence of context per image
Prefer concrete nouns: tide, shingle, harbour
donts: Do not tell viewers what to feel

taglines: Look closely. The coast is slow
A series, one frame at a time
boilerplate: Coastline is a twelve-piece art series presented in an immersive gallery viewer, with filmstrip browsing, zoom and slideshow modes for close looking.
